scope: Finite first-stage source train/val development on the completed causal publication-replay data. Not a controlled attribution against old models; no test/Real cache reads, target adaptation, model search or deployment.
jobs: Exactly two registered formal runs: uniform_replacement and balanced_source_normal, both seed42. No seed lottery or unregistered reruns. Follow-up seeds are a separate decision, not automatic six jobs.
model: Existing OnlineKGMSTCA implementation, unchanged hidden64/one layer/dropout0.2. Report honestly as existing relation-feature-enhanced MSTCA, not an implemented knowledge graph. Fresh identical initialization across paired arms, no old checkpoint or architecture comparison.
sampler: Recompute weights from current eligible train labels and case families. Uniform w=1. Balanced normal-origin: pure original-normal and inactive windows from fault cases receive equal halves of current normal mass; fault weight=1. Preserve expected normal/fault class probabilities and total mass; no RflySim suffix, no class balancing or extra class-loss weights. Both arms replacement=true and exactly162069 draws/epoch.
training: AdamW lr0.0003 wd0.0001, FocalLoss gamma2 alphaNone, clip1, no augmentation, batch512, no mixed precision, max30 epochs/arm, warmup3, cosine to0.000001. CUDA required for formal training; no automatic allocation or CPU fallback.
selection: Every epoch full34710 source-val windows, no replacement/reweighting; strict maximum overall val Macro-F1 at argmax threshold0.5, earliest exact tie. Early-stop min10 epochs, patience8, significant_delta0.002 using existing separate significant-reference logic. No test/Real/normal hover FPR used to change checkpoint or thresholds.
reporting: Report both arms, all source-val overall and stratified normal-origin/flight-mode/original-normal hover/fault-family metrics and excluded original denominators. One seed is pipeline/source-development evidence, not statistical proof or blind test. No automatic winner deployment or pretending old/new score difference isolates causal preprocessing.
cpu_check: Both arms seed42,2epochs,128draws/epoch,batch32,2validation windows per remaining source case, validation batch128. Real optimizer updates on tiny source subset ONLY for executable-path check; clearly NOT formal retraining or performance claim. Must verify paired initialization, parameters change, finite loss/gradient, metadata alignment, best checkpoint reload.
